''"No fun, copy that.|Tallissan Lintra and Starck prepare for the battle above D'Qar|}} '''Stomeroni Starck''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who flew as an [[T-70 X-wing starfighter]] [[Resistance pilot|pilot]] and [[Flight officer|Flight Officer]] in the [[Resistance]] [[Resistance navy|fleet]]. He served as [[Blue Two]]. Starck often served under [[Blue Leader]] [[Lieutenant]] [[Tallissan Lintra]], who appreciated his skill as a [[pilot]], but had to work to keep his impulsive, headstrong nature in check.{{Databank|stomeroni-starck|Stomeroni Starck}} Flying as Lintra's [[wingmate]] in the [[Battle of D'Qar]], Starck bought time for the evacuation of the [[Resistance base]] and covered the Resistance's [[MG-100 StarFortress SF-17 heavy bomber|MG-100 StarFortress SF-17]] [[bomber]]s in their attack run on the [[Mandator IV-class Siege Dreadnought|''Mandator IV''-class Siege Dreadnought]] ''[[Fulminatrix]]''.{{Databank|resistance-pilots|Resistance Pilots}} Preparing to launch from the [[MC85 Star Cruiser]] [[Raddus (MC85 Star Cruiser)|''Raddus'']] following the discovery that the fleet had been [[Hyperspace tracker|tracked]] through [[hyperspace]], Starck was killed when [[Kylo Ren's personal squadron]] [[Battle of Oetchi|destroyed the cruiser's main hangar]]. ==Equipment== [[File:Stomeroni-Starck-helmet-TLJVD.png|thumb|right|200px|Starck's flight helmet]] Stomeroni Starck wore an [[Color|interstellar-orange]] [[flight suit]] that had a [[utility belt]], and emergency [[oxygen]] tube. The suit was further covered in a white [[Flak vest|flight vest]] and was accompanied by a gray [[Guidenhauser]] [[flight harness]], a white [[FreiTek Incorporated|FreiTek]] [[life support]] unit, black [[glove]]s and [[boot]]s. Signal [[flare]]s were strapped above his left ankle. He wore a red and white [[flight helmet]], with a black and red checkered pattern on top. {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== Stomeroni Starck was portrayed by [[Noah Segan]] in the film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']],{{Film|VIII}} which was released on [[December 15]], [[2017]].{{SW|url=news/star-wars-episode-viii-to-open-december-15-2017|text=''Star Wars: Episode VIII'' to Open December 15, 2017}} The character's surname was revealed in the film's credits, while his first name was given in ''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]'', a reference book written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released in conjunction with the film.{{SW|url=news/new-star-wars-the-last-jedi-books-and-more-revealed-at-sdcc-2017|text=New ''Star Wars: The Last Jedi'' Books and More Revealed at SDCC 2017}} ==Appearances== *''[[Star Wars: Starfighter Missions]]'' *{{Film|VIII}} {{1st}} *''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Expanded Edition]]'' {{Ab|Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Expanded Edition (audiobook)}} *{{IDWAdventuresCite-2017|issue=26|story=Tales from Wild Space: Alone in the Dark}} {{Flash}} ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]'' {{1stID|Stomeroni}} *{{StarWarsShow|p09c0MXDxto|Star Wars: The Last Jedi Secrets Explained|sw_url=video/secrets-explained-the-last-jedi}} *''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' *{{Databank|resistance-pilots|Resistance Pilots}} *{{Databank|stomeroni-starck|Stomeroni Starck}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Stomeroni Starck#kanon |es=Stomeroni Starck |fr=Stomeroni Starck |ja=ストメローニ・スターク }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Starck, Stomeroni}} [[Category:Blue Squadron (Resistance) personnel]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Resistance Military officers]]
